kconfig_commands.command: trap "rm -rf .tmp_$$" EXIT; mkdir .tmp_$$; clang -Werror -fintegrated-as -fsanitize=thread --param tsan-compound-read-before-write=1 -c -x c /dev/null -o .tmp_$$/tmp.o
echo 'int __seg_fs fs; int __seg_gs gs;' | clang -x c - -S -o /dev/null
echo 'int foo(int *x) { asm goto (".long (%l[bar]) - .": "+m"(*x) ::: bar); return *x; bar: return 0; }' | $CC -x c - -c -o /dev/null
trap "rm -rf .tmp_$$" EXIT; mkdir .tmp_$$; clang -Werror -fintegrated-as -fsanitize=thread --param tsan-distinguish-volatile=1 -c -x c /dev/null -o .tmp_$$/tmp.o
echo 'void foo(void) { asm inline (""); }' | clang -x c - -c -o /dev/null
echo 'int foo(int x) { asm goto ("": "=r"(x) ::: bar); return x; bar: return 0; }' | clang -x c - -c -o /dev/null

echo 'void b(void **);void* c(void);int f(void){{asm goto(""::::l0);return 0;l0:return 1;}void *x __attribute__((cleanup(b)))=c();{asm goto(""::::l1);return 2;l1:return 3;}}' | clang -x c - -c -o /dev/null
echo 'struct flex { int count; int array[] __attribute__((__counted_by__(count))); };' | clang -fintegrated-as -x c - -c -o /dev/null -Werror
trap "rm -rf .tmp_$$" EXIT; mkdir .tmp_$$; clang -Werror -fintegrated-as -fsanitize=kernel-address --param asan-kernel-mem-intrinsic-prefix=1 -c -x c /dev/null -o .tmp_$$/tmp.o
